bibl.title: The impact of the Indian Ocean trade on the Ancient novel.

Matthew Adam Cobb (ed.), The Indian Ocean Trade in Antiquity. Political, Cultural and Economic Impacts (Abingdon - New York, 2019) pp. 191-212.
bibl.note: The literary tradition on India and the Indian Ocean trade. - The Roman novel: exotic products and patterns of consumption: Petronius' Satyrica; - Apuleius' Metamorphoses. - The Greek novel: trade routes and eastern travellers: Achilles Tatius' Leucippe and Clitophon; - Xenophon's Ephesiaca; - Heliodorus' Aethiopica. - Conclusions.
